jobs.title: Deployment Strategist
jobs.description: <p>(CSQ228R128)</p> <p><strong>About the Team</strong></p> <p>The FDE (Forward Deployed Engineering) team is a new, strategic initiative sponsored from the CEO and Founders down. Our mission is to win C-suite-sponsored, high-value AI opportunities by selling and delivering <em>outcomes</em>, not just a platform.</p> <p>You will be part of the founding team, embedded with our most strategic customers from the very first sales call, all the way through to a production-ready solution. You will be the "product manager" for the customer's problem, responsible for the "why" and "what," while our FDEs (Engineers) will be your partners responsible for the "how."</p> <p><strong>Role Description</strong></p> <p>As a Deployment Strategist (DS), you are the critical bridge between a customer's multi-million-dollar business problem and Databricks' technical solution. You are a product manager for the field, owning the technical and product direction of the engagement from initial discovery through production launch and adoption.<br><br>You will build C-suite trust, perform deep discovery to map the customer's political and technical landscape, and scope the value. You will define the Minimum Viable Product for a pilot, write the PRD that guides the engineering team, and manage the project to a successful landing. You will also lead technical discovery, shape solution architecture with FDEs, and ensure that each proposed solution can move from prototype to production.<br><br>This role requires a rare combination of executive presence, deep product thinking, technical depth, and a hands-on delivery mindset.<br><br><strong>The impact you will have</strong><strong><br></strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>C-Suite Scoping &amp; Value Definition:</strong> Partner with Sales to perform deep discovery, map the customer's organisation, quantify the business value of $10M+ problems, and define the pilot, including its MVP, success criteria, and timeline.</li> <li><strong>End-to-End Product Ownership:</strong> Author the PRD, prioritise the engineering backlog, manage scope, and act as the primary hands-on QA tester. Translate business requirements into clear data, integration, security, and operational requirements that engineers can build against.</li> <li><strong>Technical Solution Leadership &amp; Delivery:</strong> Drive the FDE build team through an agile delivery process, manage stakeholders from the C-suite to individual engineers, and unblock technical or organizational issues. Lead technical discovery and design reviews. Understand the customer's data flows, integrations, platform constraints, and operational environment; pressure-test architecture choice

jobs.description: <p><strong>REQ ID: CSQ228R125</strong></p> <p><strong>About the Team</strong></p> <p>The FDE (Forward Deployed Engineering) team is a new, strategic initiative sponsored from the CEO and Founders down. Our mission is to win C-suite-sponsored, high-value AI opportunities by selling and delivering <em>outcomes</em>, not just a platform.</p> <p>You will be part of the founding team, embedded with our most strategic customers from the very first sales call, all the way through to a production-ready solution.
